resources.string: RelateStats is not an accessibility aid. When enabled, it reads the chat title shown at the top of the screen while you use LINE, Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp, Telegram, Threads or the phone app, in order to measure how long you spend in each conversation. It does not store message content, and it never taps, types or acts on your behalf. The data stays on this phone; the app has no internet permission and cannot upload anything.
